links.outcome: Uncertainty coverage and confidence calibration of LLM outputs, meta-cognitive architecture versus single-pass baseline
links.effect: Uncertainty coverage 0.88 vs 0.75; confidence estimates more conservative and calibrated (0.57 vs 0.84); governance signals 0.96 vs 0.94; evidence grounding and contradiction detection comparable.
links.quote: The meta-cognitive system demonstrated improved uncertainty coverage (0.88 vs 0.75), enhanced governance signals (0.96 vs 0.94), and more conservative and calibrated confidence estimates (0.57 vs 0.84), while maintaining comparable performance in evidence grounding and contradiction detection.

unlisted_practices: Meta-cognitive control architecture that monitors uncertainty and detects contradictions to regulate LLM reasoning

screen.reason: Evaluates augmenting a standard LLM with an architectural meta-cognitive monitoring/self-regulation guardrail versus a standard baseline LLM on complex clinical narratives.

primary.practice: meta-cognitive uncertainty monitoring and reasoning guardrail
